From 4b837c6d7ee771f68a30f362c9f68171a95be222 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sakari Ailus <sakari.ailus@linux.intel.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jan 2019 09:01:54 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] media: v4l: uAPI: V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT is an output
 buffer type

V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT was added by commit 72148d1a57e7
("media: v4l: Add support for V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT") but the patch
missed adding the type to the macro telling whether a given type is an
output type or not. Do that now. Getting this wrong leads to handling the
buffer as a capture buffer in a lot of places.

Fixes: 72148d1a57e7 ("media: v4l: Add support for V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT")

Signed-off-by: Sakari Ailus <sakari.ailus@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil-cisco@xs4all.nl>
Signed-off-by: Mauro Carvalho Chehab <mchehab+samsung@kernel.org>

diff --git a/include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h b/include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h
index d6eed479c3a6..c0c36c165bf4 100644
--- a/include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h
+++ b/include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h
@@ -161,7 +161,8 @@ enum v4l2_buf_type {
 	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_OUTPUT_OVERLAY	\
 	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VBI_OUTPUT			\
 	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_SLICED_VBI_OUTPUT		\
-	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_SDR_OUTPUT)
+	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_SDR_OUTPUT			\
+	 || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT)
 
 enum v4l2_tuner_type {
 	V4L2_TUNER_RADIO	     = 1,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/uapi/linux/videodev2.h`**
   - The macro that checks if a given buffer type is an output type has been modified to include `V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT`. 
   - Specifically, the line:
     ```c
     || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_SDR_OUTPUT
     ```
     was followed by the addition of:
     ```c
     || (type) == V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `videodev2.h` addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (72148d1a57e7) that added support for `V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT`. The omission of this buffer type from the output type macro caused the system to incorrectly handle buffers of this type as capture buffers in various places. By adding `V4L2_BUF_TYPE_META_OUTPUT` to the output type check, the patch ensures that buffers of this type are correctly recognized and handled as output buffers, thus fixing the bug.
